relationships.subject: Polycythemia vera
relationships.evidence_quote: Among these, myeloproliferative disorders such as PV and essential thrombocythemia are the most common well-established causes.

relationships.subject: Aspirin
relationships.evidence_quote: This also explains why the patient’s pain symptoms significantly improved after adding aspirin to the treatment regimen for PDN

key_findings: Case of painful diabetic neuropathy with erythromelalgia secondary to JAK2 V617F polycythemia vera, relieved by aspirin and interferon-alpha.
